meta_description: HPC & Simulation Engineering from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Simulation as a competitive instrument — clusters, solvers and pipelines engineered for throughput. That is the contract HPC & Simulation Engineering signs. Below: what we build, in what order, and what your team holds at every gate.

Simulation-heavy industries live or die by iteration speed: how many design variants per week, how fast a risk grid recalculates, how quickly a formulation space is explored. We engineer HPC estates end-to-end: workload profiling, scheduler tuning (Slurm-class), GPU partitioning and multi-instance strategies, storage tiering for burst patterns, containerized reproducibility, and solver modernization (GPU ports, mixed precision where valid) that often delivers more throughput than hardware alone.

The cloud-burst pattern extends capacity without capital: on-prem base load with elastic burst to cloud under data-governance rules, cost-modeled per workload. We close with the operations rhythm — capacity planning, queue-fairness policy, license management — because HPC that scientists fight over is HPC underutilized.

HPC & Simulation Engineering delivery today concentrates in Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Banking & Financial Services. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
